definitionZh: caret-animation CSS属性用于启用或禁用插入caret的闪烁行为,即可编辑元素中出现的可见标记,以表示下一个字符将插入或删除的地方.
sourceDefinition: The caret-animation CSS property is used to enable or disable the blinking behavior of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.
